05 / HOW WE WORKDATA, RIGHTS & CLEAR AGREEMENTS

Good work needs
clear ground rules.

Read our approach ↗
01 / VISIBILITY

A shared workflow.

Scope, milestones, feedback rounds and costs agreed before the work begins. Decisions documented as the work develops.

02 / DATA

Privacy in the brief.

Plan data needs, access, consent and retention with your team. Use sample data for design wherever possible.

03 / OWNERSHIP

Files and rights.

Agree source files, licensing and usage rights up front. Third-party assets and any AI-assisted work are identified.
